issues.issue: The statement line 'Other receipts' is 77% donations by the report's own General Fund schedule. The extractor rule says a broad line more than half one category takes that category or is split with split_from. The user's label decision (category_decisions.csv 'other receipts' -> other, apply=label) keeps it in other. This line is 13% of governmental receipts, so 'other' is over the 10% threshold. A person needs to decide whether to split it (Donations 76,693 / licenses and permits 3,310 / other 19,568). No decision_needed entry was recorded.
